title: Parse empty query values as empty strings
author: smithers-agent
head: smithers/empty-query-values
body:

lines.text: Node requests stream into a Web Request with duplex set to half. Responses stream back without collecting their bodies first. Keep process shutdown in the host application. Client disconnect cancellation and streaming Set-Cookie handling are tracked separately.

lines.text: Middleware runs in registration order, wrapping the route handler. Call `next()` once to continue, or return a Response to finish early. Calling next twice is an error.
import { Router, cors, logger, jsonBody, body } from "tinyhttp"

Put the logger first to include middleware time. Put CORS before authentication so preflight requests can complete. Limit JSON bytes before accepting the parsed body. The body helper returns unknown unless you supply a type; validate untrusted input before using it.

Use explicit allowed origins with credentials. Browsers reject wildcard origins when credentials are enabled. The current CORS helper warns about this combination; stricter configuration validation is proposed in #33.
